:::{#def-tuning-parameter}
#### Tuning parameter

A **tuning parameter** of a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure)
is a setting $\tuning$ that the procedure needs
but does not compute from the [training set](#def-training-set) [@wikipedia_hyperparameter_machine_learning]:

$$
\predvalf{\predvar} = \candpredvalf{\tuning}{\predvar}.
$$ {#eq-tuning-parameter}

Source: @wikipedia_hyperparameter_machine_learning.
:::
